news.title: Samsung's S26 gives an advance look at what the Google-powered Apple Siri could do
news.description: The Samsung S26 has three separate AI systems with Google's Gemini, Perplexity and its own upgraded Bixby.

news.title: Thrive Capital invested about $1 billion in OpenAI at a $285 billion valuation, source says
news.description: The investment was separate from the $100 billion funding round that OpenAI is finalizing, according to a source.

news.title: Big Tech companies to meet Trump at White House to sign pledge on data center power costs
news.description: The companies attending the March 4 meeting include Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, xAI, Oracle and OpenAI, a White House official confirmed.
